A group of elite cyclops warriors lost their valuable hammer during a war against the Minotaurs. Go down into the Minotaur caves west of Kazordoon and find the chest hidden among some beds to receive an {item:Iron Hammer}.
An elite group of cyclops warriors lost their valuable hammer during a war against the Minotaurs.
Pile of loose stones west of Kazordoon
Does not need Premium or a minimum level (30+ recommended).
Bring the {item:Rope} so you can get out of the cave after going down the hole.
1. Go down to the Minotaur caves

Leave through the **main entrance** of {wiki:Kazordoon} and follow the white line on the map below to a hole with a spot for the {item:Rope}, where there are some {creature:Spider|Spiders}. Go **north** and leave by a ramp to ground level (there are {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and some {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves}). Keep following the white line **south**, cross **two bridges** and pass other mine entrances until you reach the pile of loose stones.
Path from the main entrance of Kazordoon to the Minotaur caves (white line)
On the way you may find {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves} and {creature:Bear|Bears}.
Go **west of Kazordoon** and look for the pile of loose stones.
On the surface you will find {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves}, {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers}, {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers}.
Use the {item:Shovel} on the pile of stones and go down the hole.
Down there, follow the passage **northwest** until you find a room with beds.
Map of the cave with the bed room and the chest
In the cave there are {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers}.
The quest chest is among some beds. Open it to receive the {item:Iron Hammer}.

Go back the same way to the hole you came down by and use the {item:Rope} to go up to the surface again, west of Kazordoon. Then retrace the white line (two bridges, the ramp and the rope hole) to the main entrance of Kazordoon.
Map of the 1st underground floor of the Minotaur caves
On this floor there are other ways up (the arrows on the map): one of them leads to the grassy area around the Minotaur Tower and the red X is the way to the Dwarf Mines.
